purpose: Capture a bounded profile-position move with overshoot, settling time, steady-state error, and following-error evidence.
preconditions: Idle bus profile has passed for this software commit.
Axis position is homed or explicitly zeroed in the simulation model.
Velocity, acceleration, and following-error limits are documented before the run.

bench_extension.operator_action: Record actuator direction, encoder sign, current limit, and whether the motion was unloaded or coupled to a mechanism.

operator_notes: This profile is the baseline graph for the portfolio article because it links command, response, and final error.
On hardware, start at a reduced travel distance and speed before using the full nominal value.
